## Tool and version

Tool, release/commit if known, hosted or portable HTML, and theme.

## What happened

What you expected, what actually happened, and steps to reproduce.

## Display environment

Browser and OS versions, device, browser viewport reported in Settings, OS scaling/browser zoom, preset and relevant display options. Leave out your location and other personal details.

## Evidence

Optional screenshot or error text. Remove private information before sharing.
